messages.subject: Executive application | Government relations, country strategy and stakeholder delivery
messages.body:
Dear Qatari Diar Recruitment Team,

I am submitting my executive profile for consideration across Qatari Diar’s international development portfolio. My value is strongest where major investment depends on government alignment, local participation, community confidence and disciplined stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. Across 12+ years in multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, I have built a career around government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive coordination. I work directly with ministries, regulators, communities, contractors and internal business functions, turning external expectations into clear owners, evidence and follow-through.

For Qatari Diar, I would bring practical operating-side strength in country engagement, market-entry support, local-value strategy, community and stakeholder governance, and executive coordination across long-cycle projects. I am open to Qatar, GCC and wider international mandates, including Government Relations, Country Operations, Strategic Partnerships, Stakeholder Strategy, ESG or related leadership roles.

My attached CV is tailored to Qatari Diar’s international development model. I would welcome a confidential discussion with the relevant senior talent or business leader. I am available on a 30-day notice period.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
